title: Guilds Remastered
description: Guilds Remastered recreates the World of Warcraft guild system in Minecraft, fully server-side with ranks, diplomacy, guild banks, private chat, and more. Ideal for survival and PvP servers focused on teamwork and progression.
body:
# 🛡️ Guilds Remastered

*A WoW-Inspired Guild System for Minecraft*

Guilds Remastered brings the full **World of Warcraft-style guild experience** to Minecraft. Built for hardcore survival and PvP servers, it introduces ranks, diplomacy, shared banks, alliances, and full UI-based control — all without land claims or automatic protections.

> Originally created for [Hunger Bound SMP](https://modrinth.com/mod/hungerbound), this mod turns teamwork, betrayal, and persistence into the core of gameplay.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🔰 Full Guild System

* `/guild create <name> <color>` – Create a new guild
* `/guild sethome`, `/guild home` – Set and teleport to your guild base
* `/guild rename`, `/guild disband`, `/guild quit` – Manage your guild's lifecycle
* `/guild info [guild|player]` – View info about your or another guild

### 🛡️ Rank-Based Power (w/ UI)

* Built-in ranks: `Initiate`, `Member`, `Officer`, `Guild Master`
* Configure permissions via `/guild permissions` UI:

  * Invite, kick, promote, demote
  * Set/view home
  * Bank access per tab
  * Modify rank permissions

### 💰 Guild Bank System

* `/guild bank` – Open the guild’s shared Ender Chest-style bank
* Starts with 1 tab, unlock more using `/guild donate` with **netherite ingots**
* Each tab has:

  * Deposit permission
  * Withdraw permission
  * Visibility setting per rank
* Progress tracked via `/guild progress`
* Data saved to readable `.json` files in `/world/guilds/`

### 🤝 Alliances & Diplomacy

* `/ally <guildName>` – Send an alliance request
* Accept/deny with **clickable chat buttons**
* `/ally revoke` – End an alliance
* Fully persistent across restarts

### ⚔️ PvP Control System

* `/guild toggle_friendlyfire` – Toggle friendly fire **inside your guild**
* `/ally togglepvp <guildName>` – Enable or disable PvP **between allies**
* PvP state is saved and remembered after restarts
* All requests must be confirmed via chat buttons

### 💬 Ally Chat Bridge

* `/ally chat <guildName>` – Toggle private bridge chat between two guilds
* Acts as a **cross-guild channel**
* Messages go only to participating players

### 👥 Member Tools

* View members with player heads and online status
* Promote/demote with one-click UI controls
* Hover tooltips show player info and rank

---

## 🧠 Server-Friendly

* ✅ 100% server-side – **no client mod required**
* ✅ Compatible with **Vanilla or Fabric 1.21.7**
* ✅ Integrates with vanilla `scoreboard teams` (for tablist and name formatting)
* ✅ Works with datapacks and scoreboard-based mods
* ✅ Supports [Essential Commands](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential-commands) for nickname prefix colors

---

## ❌ No Land Claims

This is **not** a land protection or factions mod. There are no automatic protections. Your guild survives through **cooperation, secrecy, and defense** — just like classic MMORPGs.
